121: And so is it logical: That [the parents] be compared [to God] for honor and reverence upon the child; as behold they also partners with the Omnipresent in [creating] him.

There are three partners: It is explained in a baraita in Tractate Niddah (31a): The man emits the white in him. The woman emits the red in him. And the Holy One, Blessed be He, blows into him, a soul, eyesight, hearing of the ear and speech.
